entities.summary: Kaunas School of Arts was a public art school, which operated from 1922 to 1940 in Kaunas, Lithuania. At the time, it was the only operating art school in Lithuania. The institution continued to exist in the Lithuanian SSR, as well as in modern Lithuania, after the restoration of Latvian independence.
